item.name: Demo: booking rules
item.description: Self-contained run of the booking rules end to end (Collection Runner, top to bottom): overbooking prevented by the database's exclusion constraint, segment mismatch, invalid stay, unknown room, bank-transfer lead time, cross-property lookup, property/role authorization (FORBIDDEN_PROPERTY vs FORBIDDEN), and the credit-card reference rules. Fetches its own tokens (alice, bob, carol) and books its own random dates; re-runnable any number of times.

item.name: 3. Same room, same dates again → 409 ROOM_UNAVAILABLE

request.description: Exact same room and dates as step 2: the Postgres exclusion constraint rejects the overlap, never a blanket DataIntegrityViolationException mapping.
Starts one day into step 2's stay (partial overlap, not identical dates): still 409 ROOM_UNAVAILABLE.
Room 102 is actually SMALL. The segment check runs before availability, so this is 422 ROOM_SEGMENT_MISMATCH even though the dates are already booked (step 2), not 409.
A zero-night stay (endDate equals startDate) fails the domain's stay-shape rule.
Room 999 does not exist in property AMS01: the room lookup fails before any other rule runs.
The bank-transfer deadline is local midnight two days before arrival (ADR-0010); arriving tomorrow leaves less than two days, so the deadline is already in the past.

item.name: Demo: unmatched payments

Fetches its own tokens (alice, carol, bank-simulator) and books its own random dates; re-runnable any number of times.

Always 503 PAYMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE with Retry-After: 5, and never books anything. With the stub running, the SLOW prefix makes it answer after 5 s, past our 2 s read timeout: three attempts, about 6.5 s. With the stub stopped (`docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop credit-card-payment-service`), the connection fails and the answer comes in about 2-3 s. Repeat it a few times and the circuit breaker opens: the answer is then immediate, without any call. Start the stub again afterwards.
